potion.name: POTION
potion.desc: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by just 20 points.

super_potion.name: SUPER POTION
super_potion.desc: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

hyper_potion.name: HYPER POTION
hyper_potion.desc: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 200 points.

max_potion.name: MAX POTION
max_potion.desc: A spray-type medicine for wounds. It completely restores the HP of a single Pokémon.
max_potion.desc_ko: 스프레이식의 상처약. 포켓몬 1마리의 HP를 모두 회복한다.

full_restore.name: FULL RESTORE
full_restore.desc: A medicine that fully restores the HP and heals any status problems of a single Pokémon.
full_restore.desc_ko: 포켓몬 1마리의 HP와 상태 이상을 모두 회복한다.

revive.name: REVIVE
revive.desc: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon. It restores half the Pokémon’s maximum HP.
revive.desc_ko: 기절해 버린 포켓몬 1마리를 건강하게 하고 HP를 절반까지 회복한다.

antidote.name: ANTIDOTE
antidote.desc: A spray-type medicine. It lifts the effect of poison from one Pokémon.
antidote.desc_ko: 스프레이식의 약. 포켓몬 1마리의 독 상태를 회복한다.

burn_heal.name: BURN HEAL
burn_heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It heals a single Pokémon that is suffering from a burn.
burn_heal.desc_ko: 스프레이식의 약. 포켓몬 1마리의 화상 상태를 회복한다.

parlyz_heal.name: PARLYZ HEAL
parlyz_heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It eliminates paralysis from a single Pokémon.
parlyz_heal.desc_ko: 스프레이식의 약. 포켓몬 1마리의 마비 상태를 회복한다.

full_heal.name: FULL HEAL
full_heal.desc: A spray-type medicine. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.
full_heal.desc_ko: 스프레이식의 약. 포켓몬 1마리의 상태 이상을 모두 회복한다.

escape_rope.name: ESCAPE ROPE
escape_rope.desc: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or a dungeon.
escape_rope.desc_ko: 길고 튼튼한 끈. 동굴이나 던전에서 빠져나올 수 있다.

repel.name: REPEL
repel.desc: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps after its use.
repel.desc_ko: 100보 걸어가는 동안 약한 야생 포켓몬이 전혀 나오지 않게 된다.

super_repel.name: SUPER REPEL
super_repel.desc: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps after its use.
super_repel.desc_ko: 200보 걸어가는 동안 약한 야생 포켓몬이 전혀 나오지 않게 된다.

max_repel.name: MAX REPEL
max_repel.desc: An item that prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 250 steps after its use.
max_repel.desc_ko: 250보 걸어가는 동안 약한 야생 포켓몬이 전혀 나오지 않게 된다.

oran_berry.name: ORAN BERRY
oran_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to heal the user by just 10 HP.

chilan_berry.name: CHILAN BERRY
chilan_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. If held by a Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s Normal-type attack.
chilan_berry.desc_ko: 포켓몬에게 지니게 하면 노말 기술을 당했을 때 위력이 약해진다.

light_ball.name: LIGHT BALL
light_ball.desc: An item to be held by PIKACHU. It is a puzzling orb that raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stat.
light_ball.desc_ko: 피카츄에게 지니게 하면 공격과 특수공격의 위력이 올라가는 이상한 구슬.

poison_barb.name: POISON BARB
poison_barb.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a small, poisonous barb that ups the power of Poison-type moves.
poison_barb.desc_ko: 독이 있는 작은 침. 지니게 하면 독타입 기술의 위력이 올라간다.

everstone.name: EVERSTONE
everstone.desc: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.
everstone.desc_ko: 포켓몬에게 지니게 하면 지닌 동안에는 진화하지 않게 되는 이상한 돌.

sitrus_berry.name: SITRUS BERRY
sitrus_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to heal the user’s HP a little.

leppa_berry.name: LEPPA BERRY
leppa_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to restore a move’s PP by 10.
leppa_berry.desc_ko: 기술 하나의 PP를 10 회복한다. 단축키로 쓰면 PP 비율이 가장 낮은 기술에 사용한다.

cheri_berry.name: CHERI BERRY
cheri_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to recover from paralysis.

chesto_berry.name: CHESTO BERRY
chesto_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to recover from sleep.

pecha_berry.name: PECHA BERRY
pecha_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to recover from poison.

rawst_berry.name: RAWST BERRY
rawst_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to recover from a burn.

persim_berry.name: PERSIM BERRY
persim_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to recover from confusion.

lum_berry.name: LUM BERRY
lum_berry.desc: A Poffin ingredient. It may be used or held by a Pokémon to recover from any status problem.
lum_berry.desc_ko: 독, 화상, 마비, 잠듦과 혼란을 치료한다.
